miniapp.name: TokenizedBlock
miniapp.subtitle: Build a block, mint it on Base
miniapp.description: Build a block — name, symbol, supply, colour, how finely it divides — and it becomes a B-20 native token on Base. No admin, no minter, supply equals cap: nobody can ever mint more or change what it says.
miniapp.ogDescription: Build a block. It becomes a B-20 token on Base — with no admin and no minter.
